placements.title: an instrument's calibration is established by validation against an independent reference standard, not by assertion alone
placements.frame: was this calibration value checked against an independent reference standard, and over what range or condition does that agreement hold?
placements.why: The supplied graph structure and strata are both empty — this is the first envelope for this repo, so no reuse candidate exists. The content (spectrograph calibrated at 88.4 MHz, verified against the June reference plates, holding across the full observing band) is not a bare one-time measurement to be filed as evidence under some other theme: it names a recurring subject an observatory's future envelopes will keep feeding — later calibration checks, other instruments, drift re-verification, other reference-plate epochs — which is exactly the grain test ("true beyond the words it describes") for a leaf rather than a fact. All three segments converge on this single theme (src-1 as narrative assertion, src-2/src-3 as the same content compressed into labelled fields), matching the position pass's single grouping. No existing hub, strata category, or leaf is close enough to warrant an INSPIRED lineage edge, and nothing in the (empty) structure makes any parent legible, so the mint stands alone with no `under`.
